blocks.text: Cloverdale condos and townhomes by price band, September 2026

37 condos and townhomes sold in September against 194 listed. The price band with the most sales was $700,001 to $800,000, with 17 sold (46% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $800,001 to $900,000 at 29%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Bands with nothing listed and nothing sold are left out. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Cloverdale?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 194 condos and townhomes listed in Cloverdale and 37 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 19%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for condos and townhomes in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The September report gave $740,000 for condos and townhomes in Cloverdale, against $673,250 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The September report showed 32 days on market for condos and townhomes in Cloverdale and a sale-to-list price ratio of 96%, against 24 days the month before.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Cloverdale?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.
